messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout: service=redwood-inference-api, change=embed-model:v2 -> embed-model:v3, target=canary 5% -> 25% over 20m, change_window=02:00-04:00 UTC. rollout_id=rl-2026-03-21-19
neha: ack. I'm on metrics and perf during warmup.
julian: noted release notes update? I pushed a short bullet in the PR but will update docs after consensus.
sam: quick heads-up — traffic shaping rule applied: canary route -> eu-west only for first 5%.
ops-oncall: 🍿 watching traces/latency. Will ping if error rate > 0.5% or p99 > 300ms.
petra: FYI QA found a minor schema mismatch for short inputs, haven't seen it in prod canary logs yet.
deploy-bot: shift step complete: 5% -> 10% (eu-west). metrics snapshot:
```
> errors(1m): 0.12% 
> p95: 210ms 
> p99: 340ms 
> embed_size_mean: 768
```
neha: p99 still a smidge high vs baseline 300ms. I'm digging into kv-cache hit-rate.
julian: can someone check model-variant routing? v3 should fallback to v2 on token-limit.
ops-oncall: seeing a pattern — tail latency spikes on requests with seq_len > 1024, mainly in eu-west-1c.
sam: @ops-oncall can you tag a sample trace id? I'll pull node and kernel metrics.
ops-oncall: trace: trace-7f3a9c, attaching snippet in logs channel.
petra: suggestion — pause percent ramp, pin traffic for eu-west to v2 while we investigate. That avoids global rollback.
neha: +1 for regional pin. We can keep canary progressing elsewhere but hold eu-west.
julian: agree. propose: pin eu-west routing to embed-model:v2 for rollout_id rl-2026-03-21, pause global at 10%.
deploy-bot: executing routing pin: eu-west -> embed-model:v2 (rollback-safe), action_id=act-8821. Will keep global canary at 10% paused.
sam: confirmed pin applied. dns/route table updated, no restarts.
ops-oncall: continuing traces; initial impression: v3's attention kernel has worse perf for long sequences on that instance type.
neha: can we repro in staging with the same instance / kernel? If yes, we should consider a quantized v3-64 build or fallback kernel.
julian: I'll open an urgent model-onboarding ticket to test quantized variant and kernel selection heuristics. tagging infra and runtime.
petra: release notes: add an explicit callout about seq_len perf for v3 and the regional pin - helps customer support.
sam: ops runbook updated with pin id and how to un-pin once fix is validated.
neha: ok let's wait for staging repro. If non-blocking, we can continue rollout to ap-south and na regions after +24m. For now: HOLD at 10%, eu-west pinned to v2.
julian: consensus check: reactions?
sam: :thumbsup:
petra: :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: :eyes:
deploy-bot: rollout paused by consensus: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-21, state=PAUSED, traffic=10%, regional_pin(eu-west)=embed-model:v2, owners=[neha,julian,sam], next_update=+20m.
neha: I'll post a short note in #release-notes after we confirm repro. Closing loop with support and CS.
julian: plan to run kernel/quantized runs now. ping when I have results, otherwise we'll rollback global to v2 if repro is quick-fail.
ops-oncall: standing by for unpin/unpause. ty everyone.
